text: Underway in the season opener!
Trace over the airwaves: 'Guard lane set; drive forward when ready.' Electric violet shirts looking organised early doors.
Point-blank chance, but it flashes wide!
GOAL! Zidroid taps it home point-blank! Real Machina lead one-nil!
Real Machina are suffocating them in the final third. Manus FC simply cannot clear their lines here.
Trace radios to clear lines.
Prompt is clean through on the right! An open net awaits Manus FC!
Prompt charges straight through the middle!
Agonisingly wide by mere inches for Manus FC!
Prompt loses balance and hits the deck.
Real Machina players collide in their own third, sending CR-7000 sprawling!
Zidroid puts in a crunching challenge right at the goal mouth, leaving Prompt grounded.
Ball rattles into the bevelled corner and the powered push-panel fires it right back out into play.
'I am clearing,' announces Trace, trying to relieve the pressure.
Push-panel launches it back out!
A communication breakdown for Manus FC as Prompt and Trace collide in their own third!
Zidroid steps in firmly in midfield, bowling Prompt over. The Real Machina man is dominating the physical duels today.
Zidroid is completely through on goal!
Zidroid storms down the right!
Manus FC tangle with each other again, down goes Prompt!
Just off target from point-blank!
GOAL! CR-7000 bundles it over the line from point-blank range! Real Machina double their advantage, two-nil!
Prompt's gyroscopes betray him in midfield as he topples over unaided.
Zidroid weaves towards the net!
GOAL! Zidroid slots it away calmly from close range! It's three-nil to Real Machina!
CR-7000 advances through the middle, shifting out towards the right channel.
Zidroid drives straight on goal!
GOAL! Zidroid makes no mistake right on the line! Real Machina are running riot, four-nil!
GOAL! CR-7000 pokes it in! Five-nil to Real Machina!
Real Machina are setting up camp deep in Manus territory. Total territorial dominance in this first half.
'Pushing along the wall,' reports CR-7000 on the left touchline.
CR-7000 is clean through!
CR-7000 strides smoothly down the left channel, closing right in on the target.
Ball finds the corner panel and gets thumped right back into the final third.
Manus FC are under relentless siege in their own half.
Fired across from two metres out on the right channel, whistling past the post!
GOAL! Zidroid tucks it in! Real Machina make it six-nil before the break!
Half time here in the opener. Real Machina lead six-nil in an utterly dominant first period against Manus FC.
Prompt radios: 'I have the ball; hold the guard lane.' Manus looking to reset in midfield.
GOAL! CR-7000 strikes from close range! It's seven-nil to Real Machina!
GOAL! Zidroid finishes from point-blank! Real Machina extend the rout to eight-nil!
Zidroid is clean through again!
GOAL! Zidroid effortlessly converts from two metres out! Nine-nil to Real Machina!
A rare slip from CR-7000 by the left touchline, but the self-righting routine kicks in immediately.
Zidroid radios: 'Freeing the ball.'
Trace puts in a solid challenge on the right touchline, sending CR-7000 to the turf.
Real Machina pressing hard once again.
GOAL! Misfortune strikes Prompt with an own goal! Real Machina hit double figures, ten-nil!
Prompt hits the deck in midfield to compound the misery, though he's already picking himself up.
CR-7000 radios: 'Getting ball off wall.' Real Machina calmly working out from their own third.
Trace carries the ball forward along the right touchline.
Zidroid tackles Prompt to the deck!
Immediate retribution in midfield as Prompt challenges Zidroid and brings the Real Machina talisman down!
Zidroid breaks free on the left channel with an open net in front of him!
Trace calls over the comms: 'I am clearing; take the next phase.' Manus FC desperately trying to survive.
GOAL! CR-7000 prods it in from point-blank range! It's eleven-nil to Real Machina!
Inches away from a twelfth! Ball skims just past the upright from two metres out.
Full time: Real Machina eleven, Manus FC nil; what an emphatic opening statement.
